description: This file contains unit tests for the Bigint class in the ZipStream library, verifying behaviors such as construction, addition, overflow handling, and representing 64-bit integers.

classes.name: BigintTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Bigint class, extending PHPUnit's TestCase, includes tests for construction, addition, overflow detection, and representation.

methods.name: testConstruct
methods.description: Tests constructing Bigint with a hexadecimal value and verifies hex string, low 32 bits, and high 32 bits.

methods.name: testConstructLarge
methods.description: Tests constructing a Bigint with a larger value, verifies hex string, low 32 bits (via bin2hex), and high 32 bits.

methods.name: testAddSmallValue
methods.description: Tests adding small values to Bigint and verifies low 32 bits, overflow status, and floating point conversions.

methods.name: testAddWithOverflowAtLowestByte
methods.description: Tests addition leading to overflow at the lowest byte boundary.

methods.name: testAddWithOverflowAtInteger32
methods.description: Tests addition causing overflow at the 32-bit integer boundary, verifying overflow status and hex representation.

methods.name: testAddWithOverflowAtInteger64
methods.description: Tests addition causing overflow at the 64-bit boundary, expects an OverflowException.
